title: Class I food recall: Crown Farms Dried Suri Cut, 200 gm, in plastic pack,
summary: The firm imported and distributed dried ribbon fish that was not properly eviscerated prior to drying.
place: The adulterated product was distributed to the following states: VA, NY, NJ, MI

title: Class II food recall: Buckhead, Tuna, 10lb cs, 12lb cs, 15lb cs, 3-5lb cs
summary: The Firm was notified by NJ Department of Health of two samples collected from tuna with reported high levels of scombrotoxin.
place: The recall product was distributed to the following States: PA, MD, NY, CT, NJ
